review_candidates.title: Network Engineer - Load Balancing
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Position Summary This position is responsible for the installation, operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of enterprise application delivery and network services for a large, multi-national organization, with a primary focus on network load balancing. The engineer will support Citrix NetScaler and Kemp LoadMaster platforms, or comparable load balancer technologies, while also maintaining working knowledge of LAN, WAN, firewall, Wi-Fi, cloud, and network automation technologies. Key Respons
eligibility_evidence: This role will can be based in various offices on a hybrid basis.

Position Summary This position is responsible for the installation, operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of enterprise application delivery and network services for a large, multi-national organization, with a primary focus on network load balancing.
Supports enterprise routing, switching, WAN, firewall/DMZ, Wi-Fi, VPN, and hybrid-cloud connectivity as secondary areas of responsibility.
Supports hybrid cloud network connectivity to Microsoft Azure and/or AWS, including related routing, security, and application-delivery integration.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Partners with application, security, cloud, and infrastructure teams to onboard applications, define load-balancing requirements, validate dependencies, and support production changes. Qualifications Skills & Competencies Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex network and application-delivery issues. Strong hands-on knowledge of Citrix NetScaler and Kemp LoadMaster is strongly preferred; comparable experience with F5 BIG-IP or another enterprise load-balancing platform is acceptable. Proficiency with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, Bash, Ansible, REST APIs, Terraform, or ARM templates. Education and Prior Experience 7+ years of experience supporting enterprise network infrastructure in a large, multi-site environment. 5+ years of hands-on experience administering enterprise load-balancing or application-delivery platforms.
